text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program provides a theoretical knowledge of economics and trade for international students. Develop a systematic command of basic theories and tools of economics and management science; Understand the basic rules and operations of international trade, including the principles of international trade bodies such as the WTO; Understand computer applications for trade analysis and management; Acquire through theory and practice, cross-cultural literacy and, improved proficiency in English, and enhanced Chinese language skills. 2. Courses Introduction Editor Notes: This program provides 11 main courses and offers different kinds of career direction in the future for international students. Main Courses The core courses are: Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Principles of Transnational Corporations Management, International Finance, Financial Management, Principles of Accounting, International Marketing,International Trade,Business Neogotiation,Chinese Language,Introduction to Chinese Culture. 3. Career Prospects Editor Notes: Most graduates are high demand by employers. Graduates are in high demand in fields of international business and economics, multinational enterprises, and governmental departments of economics, foreign trade companies, and export-oriented enterprises and securities traders. 4. University Introduction Editor Notes: SCUT is a key comprehensive research-oriented university under Project 985 and Project 211. South China University of Technology (SCUT) is one of China's leading universities. South China University of Technology is a key comprehensive research-oriented university under Project 985 and Project 211. It operates under the direct leadership of the State Ministry of Education. SCUT is a member of Project 985 and Project 211 which means top excellent in teaching and research, it is one of the universities approved by MOE to accept international students on Chinese Government Scholarships, Learn More>> 5. School of Economics and Commerce Editor Notes: It is a key school of economics and commerce in south China. 4.1 Introduction of the Department The School enjoys abundant teaching resources, excellent education conditions and strong academic atmosphere. The School is recognized as one of the rapid developing schools in the university. The School promotes all-round development in teaching and research, serves regional economic and social development, and strengthens international cooperation. 4.2 Faculty Subject: International Trade and Industrial Cluster Professor Kuang Guoliang Master of Industrial Economy of South China University of Technology Subject: Management Economics Professor Long Zhihe Doctor of Management Science and Engineering in Southwest Jiaotong University, China(2000) ​ Subject: E-Business Professor Qi Ming Dean of Intellectual Property Information Engineering Institute 6.
